diagnostics.message:
`x-telo-context-element-from-item: rows` is now written `x-telo-context-element-from-item: 0/rows`.
`x-telo-context-element-from-item` names the field whose chain types the binding with a relative JSON pointer from the object holding the field the region is declared on (`0/rows` for a sibling, `2/rows` two levels up), so a region on a list column's own field can reach the list's `rows`; a bare field name could name only a field of the enclosing array entry.
Run `telo migrate` to apply it.
